I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-team. It says: "Noted, Tobias. Expense reports are due Friday, October 16. If you'd like a reminder closer to the day, just tell me."

His message was a reminder rather than a request, so I only acknowledged it. I worked out the date from the simulation clock: today is Wednesday, October 14, which makes Friday the 16th. I haven't set up a reminder; I'll only do that if he asks.
